decisions.reason: The 12-clip launch batch is a task-local assignment and does not change the persistent target of 140 approved clips per month.
Arden's long-form YouTube videos remain the substantive source collection; B-roll is supplementary visual footage governed by the separate B-roll integration Requirement.
The instruction to use a full lesson or story is already covered by the existing substantive-moment standard and does not necessarily alter it.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the clean-editing rule and the prohibition on heavy animations and flashy transitions.
The source message does not establish or change any hook-selection criterion.
The preexisting completeness standard already requires a full lesson, story, or point, and a same-message MODIFY already records the newly explicit unfamiliar-viewer understandability rule.
The 70-to-85-second duration range was already current, so the source message reiterates rather than changes it.
A same-message INTRODUCE already fully records that client approval is required before publication.
A same-message INTRODUCE already fully records the low-volume, voice-priority background-music rule.
A same-message INTRODUCE already fully records the requirement to use B-roll only where it naturally supports and strengthens the message.
The white-text-only and no-text-effects rules were already current before this message, which merely reiterates them.
The batch assignment and Google Drive submission instructions do not change the dedicated Instagram account's setup or purpose.
